description: A gradient area with visible dots and a value axis on the right edge of the plot.
overview: A single series drawn as a smooth area with a soft gradient fill, a dot at every value and a value axis on the right. Use it when readers need to read exact values off the chart, not just see the trend.
usage: Swap `chartData` for your own records, point each `dataKey` at your fields and set the series label and color in `chartConfig`. Set `orientation` on the value axis to move it to the left, and adjust `tickCount` to make it denser or sparser. Drop the dots if they feel busy on longer series.
notes: The plot is keyboard accessible: focus it and use the arrow keys to step the tooltip through the months. You can render several copies on one page without their gradients clashing.
